title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Name & Address
description: Every package shall bear the name and complete physical address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer, or the importer.
legalAct: Legal Metrology Act, 2009 & Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
prescribedRequirement: Full postal address with pincode and state; manufacturer/packer designation explicitly declared.

title: Generic Name of Commodity
description: The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package and, in case of packages with more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each product shall be mentioned.
prescribedRequirement: Prominent generic / descriptive commodity name on Principal Display Panel.

title: Net Quantity Declaration in Standard Units
description: The net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package shall be declared, in accordance with Rule 8 and the Second Schedule.
prescribedRequirement: Declared in g, kg, mL, L, m, mm, cm, or number (N). No non-standard symbols like 'gms', 'kilo', 'lit'.

title: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be declared on the package in clear numerals and letters.
prescribedRequirement: Format like MM/YYYY, 'Pkd: Month Year', or 'Mfg: Month Year' legible to consumer without decoding.

title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Declaration
description: The retail sale price of the package shall clearly be declared as 'Maximum or Max. Retail Price ₹.... inclusive of all taxes' or 'MRP ₹.... incl. of all taxes'.
prescribedRequirement: Must include Indian Rupee symbol (₹) or Rs., explicit phrase 'incl. of all taxes'. Over-writing or sticker alteration without authorization is an offence.

title: Consumer Care Details
description: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number and e-mail address of the person or the office who may be contacted in case of consumer complaints.
prescribedRequirement: Four mandatory components: Contact Designation/Name, Postal Address, Phone Number / Toll-Free Helpline, and valid Email ID.

title: Minimum Height of Numeral and Letters
description: The height of any numeral and letter in the declaration of net quantity and other mandatory declarations shall not be less than the minimum height specified with respect to the area of the Principal Display Panel.
prescribedRequirement: For PDP <= 50 cm²: min 1.0mm (blown/embossed 2.0mm); PDP 50-100 cm²: min 1.5mm; PDP 100-500 cm²: min 2.5mm; PDP 500-2500 cm²: min 4.0mm; PDP > 2500 cm²: min 6.0mm.

title: Declaration of Quantity with Standard Units
description: No declaration of quantity shall be expressed in units other than metric units, and symbols used must conform to standard international/legal metrology symbols.
prescribedRequirement: Mass in g or kg; Volume in mL or L; Length in mm, cm or m. Symbols must not have plural 's' or trailing periods (e.g., 'kg' not 'kgs.').

title: Manner and Legibility of Declarations
description: Declarations shall be legible, distinct, unambiguous, in English or Hindi in Devanagari script, and conspicuous against the background colour.
prescribedRequirement: High contrast with background; not obscured by graphics, illustrations, or fold seams.

title: Unit Sale Price (USP) Declaration
description: The unit sale price shall be declared on packages containing more than 1 kg or 1 L (or packages containing less than 1 kg / 1 L) in terms of price per gram/kg or mL/Litre to enable price transparency.
prescribedRequirement: e.g., '₹0.80 / g' or '₹45.00 / kg' rounded to nearest paise, placed adjacent to or below MRP.

title: Country of Origin for Imported Products
description: Where a package contains an imported commodity, the name of the country of origin or manufacturer shall be explicitly declared on the label.
prescribedRequirement: Explicit declaration such as 'Country of Origin: India' or name of foreign exporting nation.

title: Best Before / Expiry Date for Perishables
description: For commodities that may become unfit for consumption after a period, best before or use-by date specifying month and year or days from manufacture.
prescribedRequirement: Format: 'Best before [X] months from packaging' or specific calendar date DD/MM/YYYY.
